constraints: Cold canon identities remain compact until causally materialized.
No current office, location, equipment, relationship, command or achievement is invented from future canon.
Materialized identities leave aggregate-only resolution for the affected interval.
goals: advance only slow life-course state that can be resolved safely for cold active-canon identities
materialize exact or lite owners when causal contact makes detail consequential
reconstruction_policy: Use the active-canon roster, stable seeds and only supported historical/campaign facts; unknown present details remain unknown.
replanning_policy: At each boundary or causal wake, keep cold identities aggregate unless a consequential interaction requires lawful materialization.
safe_compaction_policy: Cold roster spans may compact only when no identity materializes or crosses a material life-course threshold inside the span.
standing_orders: preserve cold roster compression without survival or development advantage
hand causally active identities to exact or lite owners before consequential resolution
